mapper.select: SELECT order_kind, from_status_code, to_status_code, is_active FROM wms.status_transition_rule WHERE is_active = TRUE AND order_kind = #{order_kind} ORDER BY from_status_code, to_status_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms.order_status_history ( order_kind, order_no, from_status_code, to_status_code, changed_by, change_reason, changed_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{order_kind}, #{order_no}, #{from_status_code}, #{to_status_code}, #{changed_by}, #{change_reason}, now(), #{changed_by}, #{changed_by} )
